purpose: Operational partner-access policy for nationwide appliance pickup routing. This file controls how approved partners may receive opportunities; it does not create public pages, establish service coverage, or change SEO indexability.

shared.label: Shared lead access
shared.description: An approved partner may receive a qualifying opportunity that also matches other eligible partners. Assignment and customer contact access remain controlled by routing policy.

primary.label: Primary territory access
primary.description: An approved partner may be designated as the primary operator for a defined market after explicit territory review and assignment.

backup.label: Backup or overflow access
backup.description: An approved partner may receive opportunities when a primary or direct operation needs backup capacity.

waitlist.label: Future territory waitlist
waitlist.description: An approved or applicant partner may be retained for future review but cannot receive routed customer contact solely because of waitlist status.
